correct.description: Elbows stay pinned at the sides, handle starts near the chest and is pushed down to full extension with control

common_errors.description: Elbows drift away from the torso instead of staying pinned
Torso leans into the pushdown to help generate momentum
Handle does not reach full extension at the bottom

thresholds._status: SEED values only -- placeholders pending real field-measured tuning per EXERCISE_LIBRARY.md §4. Not authoritative; do not treat as validated.

rep_counting._note: SIGNAL-DIRECTION INVERSION vs. most other exercises: a pushdown's between-reps REST reference is elbow FLEXED (~90 degrees, low angle), and its effort PEAK is full EXTENSION (~170 degrees, high angle) -- the opposite of squat/pushup/curl/press, where rest=high-angle/extended and peak=low-angle/flexed. "top"/"bottom" here are labeled by INTUITIVE rest-vs-peak meaning (top=between-reps reference, bottom=target ROM), not by which numeric angle is literally larger. Flagged explicitly for whoever wires Stage 5b: the generic rep-counter FSM (detector/rep_counter.py) assumes rest=peak-angle/effort=trough-angle, so this exercise's primary-angle signal will need inverting (e.g. track 180-elbow_angle, or a re-derived signal) rather than being fed raw elbow angle like the other exercises.

coaching_cues.setup: Elbows at your sides, handle near your chest
coaching_cues.execution: Push down to full extension, keep elbows still
coaching_cues.set_complete_no_flags: Great set. Elbows locked in place.
coaching_cues.set_complete_with_flags: Good set. Next time, watch your {flag_body_part} — {flag_cue}.

flag_cues.elbow_drift: Keep your elbows pinned to your sides
flag_cues.partial_rom: Push all the way to full extension

elbow_injury.modification: Reduce weight and range of motion. Stop if you feel elbow pain.

wrist_injury.modification: Use a straight-bar attachment instead of rope, or reduce weight.

hypertension.modification: Avoid breath-holding. Breathe out as you push down.

model_assist.notes: Advisory only. May detect rule-less errors (e.g. shoulder shrug compensation, uneven push). Cannot override rep count or safety flags. Default off until eval passes.

camera_guidance.framing_note: Phone ~2m away, side profile at hip height, so elbow drift and torso lean are both visible.
